'''June 2000 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Junior's Comics, Austin, TX on 10 June 2000. [[Matt Lush]] won it. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d869">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-10-austin-tx-6-10d869/ austin-tx-6-10], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 10 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-10-austin-tx-6-10d869/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Junior's Comics, Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Lush]]
